title: OPN has been stuck in a 0.0511-0.0515 box for 8 hours. Which way does it go?
author: FarInspector1873
selftext:
OPN popped about 3% early this morning (Oct 23, IST), from roughly 0.0504 to 0.0520. Then it went quiet. For the last 8 hours it has been squeezing between about 0.0511 and 0.0515 on the 15m.

A few things I noticed:

* The top of the range has been rejected 8 times and the bottom has held 6 times. That's a lot of tests for a short timeframe.
* The pole was only about 3%, so this is a very small move to base a pennant on.
* Volume was strong during the pop and has faded a lot over the last few hours.
* The last green candle pushed right up to the upper line, around 0.0515, and the next candle stalled under it.

If a 15m candle closes above about 0.0515, the breakout case is simple: the pole height of about 0.0015 would suggest a rough target near 0.0530. If it loses 0.0511, the whole idea is dead.

Honest take: this is tiny, and 15m patterns fail all the time. I'm mainly curious whether so many touches make the level stronger or weaker. When a level gets hit this many times, does it usually break?
